challenge.method: Tested three possible misidentifications against the publisher text: GNU Library Public License version 2 in the introductory note, ordinary GPL version 2 in §3, and the inline linking exception in §6.
challenge.results: The introductory note identifies Library GPL version 2 as the predecessor. Section 3 describes a change of license for a particular copy after its notices are altered. Section 6 permits specified linking and distribution subject to its conditions. Each passage has a distinct function within the document headed Lesser GPL version 2.1.
